segments.text:
Almighty God, and heauenly Father, ſince thou diddest once in ſuch wiſe vouchſafe to arme thy ſeruant. Ieremiah with the inuincible power of thy holy ſpirit, that at this day his doctrine humbles vs: grant wee may learne willingly to ſubiect our neckes to thy yoke, and ſo to receiue, yea and to imbrace whatſoeuer thou haſt taught vs by this thine holy ſeruant, that thou raiſing vs vp by thine hand, and being vnderpropped by thy power and defence, we may fight hand to hand againſt the world, and the prince thereof, Satan himſelfe: that in the meane while each of vs in our places and callings may ſo confidently relie vpon thy power, that wee may not doubt to expoſe our liues to all dangers, as oft as need ſhall require: and that we may valiantly fight, and alſo perſeuere, till the laſt encounter be finiſhed, when hauing runne out our
race, we may in the end attaine to that bleſſed reſt which is reſerued for vs in heauen, by Ieſus Christ our Lord. Amen.
